title: Payment Token Terminologies
applicability: Applies conditionally to Segment 100 tokenized transactions and related security/entry-mode context.

businessRequirements.title: A payment token used as Segment 100 Account Number shall be a valid 13-19 digit token value subject to account validation and designated token BIN rules.
Payment Token Expiration Date shall be populated in the PAN Expiration Date field when token processing requires it.
In-App token cryptogram data shall use the source-defined 28-byte or 56-byte base64 representation and token-data-block interpretation.
Tokenized Segment 100 transactions shall use a POS Entry Mode that identifies the token presentment mode.

testCases.positive: Token expiration, cryptogram, and entry mode agree with token context

testDataStatus: Generic account/token dependency rules exist; dedicated tokenized AI artifacts and tokenization-specific converter rules are not yet available.
remaining: Obtain tokenized AI artifacts and security-safe cryptogram fixtures.
Confirm exact token BIN, Luhn, expiration, and POS Entry Mode rules with the tokenization implementation.
